model: Virtual subtraction and the virt_base addition are modulo 2^64. Physical addresses, sizes, and span ends stay unbounded integers and are refused when they leave validated RAM or reach 2^64. An accepted physical result is phys_base plus the masked virtual offset, with no second mask.

attempt001_scalars.source: test_bootargs_progress.fixture, the scalars named by that test. This run did not read a boot log or the machine.

differential.each_layout: one random in-range span of 1..MAX_ADT bytes, virtual to physical to virtual; also the last 16 KiB page when mem_size is larger than one page
invalid_classes: size that makes offset+size exceed mem_size
physical address at or one byte past the usable end
physical address one byte below phys_base
address 2^64-1 with size 2, whose masked sum is 1
deterministic_refusals: phys_base 2^64-PAGE and mem_size 2 pages: the unmasked end is 2^64+PAGE and the masked end is PAGE; validate_bootargs raises
differential.nonwrap_vector: virt_base 0xc078000, devtree 0x13010000, devtree_size 377476 translates to 0x809010000 with and without a mask

conclusion: On this host sample the helper matches the 64-bit unsigned model. Wrapping is limited to the virtual offset and the virt_base addition. Physical range checks reject ends that a mask would fold back into range. No parser change is indicated by these results.
limits: Bounded random sample plus the fixed vectors above, not an exhaustive search of the u64 space. A host match is not a guest launch, a Darwin boot, or a keyboard result. Root's controller fix stays with Claude and Astra.
